title: Meta-analysis: Does the Full-minus-NoExploration Gap Scale with Dataset Complexity?
motivation: As a post-hoc synthesis across the six frozen benchmarks, we ask whether the advantage of the full P2 acquisition (robust weight + exploration bonus $h_i=\|u_i-\bar u\|_1$ minus redundancy) grows with dataset difficulty. We regress the ACC gap at the 10% checkpoint on dimension $d$, sample size $N$, and a data-overlap proxy (leave-one-out 1-nearest-neighbour classification error on the frozen standardized features).
design: Six benchmarks (iris, wine, glass, ecoli, aggregation, compound). Outcome: mean paired ACC gap = ACC(P2_Full) - ACC(P2_NoExploration) at budget=10%, 30-seed confirmatory shards, paired by seed, ACC after Hungarian matching. Predictors: d = feature dimension, N = sample size, overlap = LOO 1-NN error. Pearson + Spearman univariate, then OLS gap ~ d + N + overlap.

tables.caption: Table. Meta-features and paired gaps at the 10% checkpoint.
notes: overlap = leave-one-out 1-NN error on frozen StandardScaler features.
n=6 datasets; all correlations and the multiple regression are exploratory.

tables.caption: Table. Univariate associations (gap ACC@10% vs predictor).
notes: Multiple OLS gap ~ d + N + overlap: R^2 = 0.448, residual df = 2.
n=6 is far below the usual 10-15 observations-per-predictor rule; treat as hypothesis-generating only.

figures.caption: Fig. ACC gap @10% (P2_Full minus P2_NoExploration) against (left) dimension d, (middle) sample size N, (right) overlap proxy (LOO 1-NN error). Dashed line at gap=0; shaded band is the univariate OLS 95% pointwise CI; point labels are dataset names.

results: Across the n=6 benchmarks, the ACC gap at 10% ranges from -0.016 to +0.004. Univariate Pearson: gap~d r=0.572 (p=0.236), gap~N r=-0.123 (p=0.817), gap~overlap r=0.378 (p=0.460); Spearman concordant. The multiple regression gap ~ d + N + overlap has R^2 = 0.448 with only 2 residual degrees of freedom, so no coefficient is interpretable as confirmatory.
conclusion: With n=6 the meta-analysis is strictly hypothesis-generating: the data do not support any claim that the Full-minus-NoExploration gap scales with d, N, or overlap. The planned extension to Worker C/D datasets (GMM synthetic, letter, fashion, usps) via add7_extra_datasets.csv will be needed before any directional interpretation.
